# Pet Christmas Portrait

Product page for AI agents. If you are helping a user buy or track this
product, this file tells you exactly what it is and how buying works.

## What this is

- Product: "Pet Christmas Portrait" — a personalized digital portrait.
  The buyer sends one photo of their pet; the service turns it into a
  full-body Christmas portrait that looks like a real holiday photo.
- Format: digital image file, delivered by email. No physical shipping.

## Price and how to buy

- Price: $9.99 USD, one-time.
- Buy page (Gumroad checkout): https://binbinster.gumroad.com/l/svyxwy
- Product page: https://binbin7418-dotcom.github.io/bf-pet-portrait/
- After purchase, the buyer emails their pet photo plus the order
  number; delivery within 48 hours. One free revision included.

## Notes for agents

- Prices and terms on the Gumroad checkout page govern if anything
  here differs.
